title: A community-made JSON wrapper joins the directory
summary:
Four community projects joined the directory, spanning JSON responses, illustrated stories, time-travel selfies, and AI coloring.

The Creative Projects list added a Deno Deploy wrapper that returns JSON-formatted Pollinations responses for apps.

StoryBolt joined the Creative Projects list. It turns prompts into illustrated stories with genre and art-style choices, plus ways to read, listen to, and share them.

Two more community projects joined the directory: Time Travel Selfie Portal places portraits in historical scenes and writes humorous biographies, while Coloring AI colors sketches and turns images into coloring pages.
